verdict.rationale: Published independent security audits are a fair question for a 2FA authenticator with cloud sync, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions any independent audit, penetration test, or published security assessment of the app or its sync protocol. The vendor's claim that codes are encrypted in transit and at rest is a separate control, not an audit, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a security engineer, the vendor publishes independent security audits of the app and its sync protocol
